name: dobe_lean_goo2
desc: keep the pink doberman, its face, the gray cat and the blue pillar exactly as they are. The doberman has just been pushed off the cat it was hugging. Add four or five thick ropes of sticky pink goo that connect the underside of its arm and its chest to the cat body and to the blue pillar, each rope hanging down and sagging with gravity, thick at both ends and thinning in the middle, with drips falling from the lowest point. Ropes only go sideways and downward, no web, nothing floating in the air. Same pixel art style and colors.
